title: snapshot.snapshot_atmospherics payload
description: M4 § M9 firehose surface. Placeholder payload at M4 (placeholder=true; empty atm_ids for default scenarios). M19 fills with real atm states. Fires at scenario start and on every objective transition.

placeholder.description: True when emitted by M4 with a stub payload; M19 producer fills real kernel data and clears this flag.

atm_ids.description: Per-atm unit: { atm_id, kind: RoomCell|PipeNetwork|Suit|Canister|Lung|DeviceInternal, volume_l, moles_per_gas, temperature_k, total_pressure_pa, flags }.
